cryptographic_integrity_reconciliation.terminology_standard: Cryptographically checksummed using SHA-256 (NIST FIPS 180-4). Loose statements such as 'cryptographically signed' are reconciled to 'cryptographically checksummed using SHA-256'.
cryptographic_integrity_reconciliation.reconciliation_summary: All repository-relative asset paths from TASK-01 through TASK-04 are verified bitwise on disk against their recorded SHA-256 digests.

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Native Scientific Source of Truth
tiers.target: Raw Provider NetCDF-4 / GRIB2 / GDAC Profiles
tiers.role: Immutable baseline authoritative source of truth for all exact queries, scientific collocations, and regulatory compliance.
tiers.precision: Full floating point (float32/float64 natively stored in provider array)

tiers.format: Zarr v2/v3 (Lossless blosc/zstd / uncompressed numeric arrays with categorical mask)
tiers.role: High-throughput processing representation used for pipeline decimation, spatial partitioning, profiling, and fast array slicing. Non-authoritative for scientific truth under strict ADR-0005, but bitwise lossless to source arrays.
tiers.precision: Lossless IEEE-754 float32 / categorical uint8 mask

tiers.format: r16float / r16uint Zstandard compressed binary payloads
tiers.role: Interactive 3D raymarching in WebGPU/WebGL2 Volume Lab viewports. Approximate visual textures.
tiers.precision: Quantized / downsampled float16 or uint16 (max error ~0.00781 deg C f16, ~0.00016 deg C u16)

vertical_resolution.strategy: Non-uniform depth Look-Up Table (LUT) with exact binary search (bisect_left / bisect_right).

horizontal_resolution.strategy: Dual-mode: Nearest native grid node (default) or bilinear interpolation across 4 surrounding nodes.

temporal_resolution.strategy: Exact UTC ISO-8601 matching with fallback to nearest available daily timestep within valid temporal window.

missing_value_safeguards.policy: Missing values, fill values, land masks, below-seabed voxels, and QC-rejected cells are NEVER converted to physical zero (0.0 deg C).
missing_value_safeguards.response_behavior: When value_state != VALID, scientific_value is null/None and value_state is explicitly populated.

provisional_render_pick_reconciliation.workflow: Client performs raycast hover -> receives ProvisionalRenderPickResponse (response_type='approximate_render_sample') -> on user click/detail request -> client calls POST /api/v1/queries/value with world ray hit position -> service maps world coordinate to geodetic lat/lon/depth -> executes authoritative exact query -> returns ExactValueQueryResponse (response_type='authoritative_scientific_value').

catalog_endpoints.summary: List all active and historical dataset snapshots, variables, temporal classifications, and product identifiers.
Retrieve complete metadata, spatial bounding box, depth profile LUT, time axis, and coordinate transforms for a specific dataset.
Retrieve all canonical scientific variables, CF standard names, canonical units, and valid numerical ranges for a dataset.
Retrieve temporal axis coverage, available timesteps, time semantics (observation time, forecast lead time), and valid intervals.
Retrieve multiresolution volume rendering manifest, brick geometry, LOD levels, quantization scale/offset, and brick URL templates.
Retrieve server capabilities, supported coordinate spaces, selection methods, render backends (WebGPU/WebGL2), and resource limits.

authoritative_query_endpoints.summary: Execute an authoritative exact-value point query against native NetCDF arrays, resolving geodetic coordinates, depth LUT, and exact numerical value.
Execute an authoritative vertical profile query extracting an exact 1D column cast across all vertical depth levels at a target lat/lon and timestep.
Reconcile a provisional GPU raymarch pick by translating world 3D ray hit coordinates to geodetic coordinates and evaluating native NetCDF truth.
